content.value: Consider 'a hash table of size 8 with hash function h(k) = k mod8 . Draw the table that results (12 after inserting in the given order, the values 20, 27, 14, 49, 18 for each of the scenarios below:
i) When collision is handled by separate chaining.
ii)When collision is handled by linear problem.
iii) When collision is handled by double hashing using a second hash function h'(k) = 5−(k mod 5).
